test_title: PYST 40: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. Q is the immediate neighbour of M and R. N is sitting third to the left of Q. O is the immediate neighbour of R and N. R is sitting second to the left of N. Who is sitting between M and N when considered from the right of N?
solution:
Six people **M, N, O, P, Q and R** are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

1. N is sitting third to the left of Q.

2. R is sitting second to the left of N. 

3. Q is the immediate neighbour of M and R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05cbe2c458d5af68c6d38bc2617c0fa1513e35dd4551fbc01da4af89a673dae9.png] 

4. O is the immediate neighbour of R and N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6597743390190087c8f4567dd8b17008b5a651bf0e814fe62069ab1ec1633b8a.png] 

P, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50d4ecf75b994d1bc7a3b4eb269ce9256f30c54da6bb2c18aa6be2d25c8adbe9.png] 

Clearly, P is sitting between M and N when considered from the right of N.

Hence, '**P**' is the correct answer.
